content: {"like":["Enjoys high‑tech, visually stunning sci‑fi with tense, alien‑style atmospheres","Values strong ensemble casts and engaging, well‑crafted storylines in action and thriller films","Prefers classic Westerns and crime dramas showcasing iconic actors like Clint Eastwood","Appreciates films with memorable, well‑directed camera work reminiscent of Hitchcock and De Palma","Loves movies where charismatic leads carry the narrative, especially in modern action‑comedy hybrids"],"dislike":["Dislikes films that feel like open‑ended sequels or lack narrative closure","Avoids movies with lifeless, robotic characters lacking human depth","Rejects low‑quality productions with misleading marketing or poor special effects","Favors films that age well, avoiding those that feel hokey or dated","Steers clear of movies that kill key characters or leave no sequel potential"]}
